about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Sport Autobiography Dynamic ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Sport Autobiography Dynamic was a premium trim level offered on the L494-generation Range Rover Sport from 2013 to 2022. Under the bonnet, it could be specified with either the SDV8 — a 4.4-litre V8 diesel — or the supercharged AJ-V8, a 5.0-litre V8 petrol. Both are high-performance engines that sit at the top of the Sport range, and both have their own established wear patterns that we address as standard during a rebuild. The Autobiography Dynamic trim is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace SDV8 or AJ-V8 engines for every Range Rover Sport Autobiography Dynamic on the road.

cards.body: A 4.4-litre V8 diesel fitted to the Range Rover Sport Autobiography Dynamic from 2013 to 2022. Shares the same timing chain wear pattern as the TDV6 and SDV6 across the Range Rover range. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, and gaskets as standard on every SDV8 rebuild.
cards.cta: Check Your SDV8 Range Rover Sport Autobiography Dynamic

cards.body: A 5.0-litre supercharged V8 petrol fitted to the Range Rover Sport Autobiography Dynamic from 2013 to 2022. Timing chain wear and coolant system leaks are the established pattern for this engine family. We replace timing chains, valve seals and coolant components as standard on every AJ-V8 rebuild.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport Autobiography Dynamic ENGINE
compatibility.intro: Because the Autobiography Dynamic was offered with two distinct V8 engines, it's essential to confirm which one your car has before any work begins. Fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming an SDV8 part will work on an AJ-V8 car — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (SDV8 or AJ-V8) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
